name: FileDialogPreview
description: The same dialog in the page flow, for documentation and screenshots. Real parts, non-modal.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it starts open when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultUri
props.description: Start here; otherwise the last place used in this session.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: How entries show at first when uncontrolled. Default `list`.

props.name: mode
props.description:
Choose existing files.
Choose where to write.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state, after a dismissal and after a run succeeds. Not called while a run is cancelled in place.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view the person picks.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open. Controlled while defined.

props.name: providers
props.description: The locations offered, in order. One hides the location list.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's title. Default Open, Open files or Save as.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it. Omit when controlling `open`.

props.name: view
props.description: How entries show. Controlled while defined. `grid` needs `thumbnail` on the location.
